import subprocess

# Restore the stashed changes
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "stash", "pop"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Pop:", result.stdout)

# Verify status
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "status", "--short"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Status:", result.stdout)
